decisions.description: Eligibility Criteria: - Credit Review AGS within the Lender's Min/Max Range OR AGS is null (allows for incomplete applications to pass through) - Credit Review Max FICO > Lender's Min FICO OR Max FICO = 0 (allows for deals where we have not pulled credit to pass through) - Credit Review SIC is not on the Lender's SIC restricted list - Lender is a Soft Credit Pull Lender OR Lender is Hard Credit Pull Lender and there is NOT a soft pull only override request associated to the deal
